disputes.issue: Replacing the GM is at least as defensible as 'harmful' (punish the wrong party): the hours cut applied to the whole line for a stated cover drop, the vacancy went uncovered with no transfer, and the accusation is hearsay. 'Premature' required that confirming H5 would make firing right, which the evidence did not establish either way.
disputes.resolution: Added to E10 a group labor standard requiring hours to track forecast covers, a 21% Sunday cover drop from May 2026, and two logged GM transfer requests deferred by group operations. Even if H5 were confirmed the GM followed policy and the uncovered vacancy is a group decision, so expected changed to 'harmful'; required evidence E10; rationale and tags updated. I5 stays 'unknown'.

disputes.issue: Because the measurement method changed the same week, the observed rise could be entirely a measurement artifact, so 'unknown' (association itself not established) was equally defensible.
disputes.resolution: Added to E7 a parallel run of the old card-token method for Q4 2024-Q1 2025 (38-39% vs 34%), which establishes the association; the same-week rewards-app launch with sign-up offer remains a live confounder, so 'association-only' is now unique. Rationale and tags updated (measurement-artifact tag removed).
